result:
Round 2 audit complete. The single round-1 defect is fixed, and I confirmed it independently rather than on the worker's word.

**[1.1] resolved.** `answer.tex:1` is now `\section*{...}`; the string `subsection` is gone from the file, and all three siblings (`p1`, `p2`, `p3`) now open at the same level, so Ex. 2.4 will no longer nest under Ex. 2.2 in the assembled document.

**No prose was smuggled in with the fix.** File size moved 1402 → 1399 bytes — exactly the three characters of `sub` — and lines 3–21 are character-identical to the round-1 text I recorded. Body word count is still 212, unchanged, which is what I asked for.

**Re-verified, no regressions:** my own wrapper compile exits 0 at 1 page with zero overfull/underfull/undefined/warning lines; the 110 dpi render reads clean with the heading now at section weight over two lines; R5 clean (no `\documentclass`/`\usepackage`/document env, no labels, no graphics, no absolute paths, so no namespace collision is possible); `lint_output.py` exits 0 with `answer.tex` as the only file in OUTPUT; all round-2 scratch (`assembled.*`, `p3only.tex`, `fixed-1.png`) correctly stayed in PLAYGROUND; `downloads.md` still accurately records nothing installed.

Two things I noted for the master but am deliberately not treating as defects: the "register saving is the smaller half" claim is qualitative and unsourced, which the brief explicitly permits, and 212 words against the 190 target is inside R8's tolerance — trimming further would cost a link in the causal chain.

VERDICT: PASS
